meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查 Codex 与 LazyCodex 安装,揪出过时或损坏的配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你用 LazyCodex 或 Codex,想确认本地安装健康、与最新版一致。
copy.tagline_en: Check Codex and LazyCodex installs for drift, staleness, or breakage.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LazyCodex or Codex and worry your local install may be unhealthy or outdated.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会检查你本地的 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 安装，对比最新源码，给出一份 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告，每项结论都附上对应命令输出或文件作证据。它只做诊断，不改动你的安装、配置和仓库。
howto.when: 当你要求做 doctor 或健康检查、提到 “LazyCodex”、“lazycodex-ai”、“omo-codex” 等关键词，或安装、更新、改配置后 Codex 行为异常时触发。

say.text: 帮我跑一次 LazyCodex doctor 健康检查
say.note: 会先同步最新源码，再逐项核对

say.text: 我更新 Codex 后行为不对，查一下问题在哪
say.note: 输出带证据的 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告

say.text: 检查我的本地安装和最新源码有没有偏移

howto.what_en: Claude inspects your local LazyCodex and Codex CLI install against the latest sources, then returns a PASS/WARN/FAIL report where each verdict cites the command output or file behind it. Diagnosis only — it never changes your install or config.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a doctor or health check, mention LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, or omo-codex, or when Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change.

say_en.text: Run a LazyCodex doctor health check for me
say_en.note: It re-syncs the latest sources, then checks each item

say_en.text: Codex has acted oddly since I updated — find out why
say_en.note: You get an evidence-bound PASS/WARN/FAIL report

say_en.text: Audit my local install against the latest sources
say_en.note: Diagnosis only; your install stays untouched
